From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Post-discovery: Schedule technical deep dive (60-90m)

Hi Alice / Raj —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a request to schedule the next step: a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra teams so we can align on integration, performance targets, and data access.

Key points from discovery:
- Goal: Integrate Redwood Inference for real-time clinical NLP and batch inference for analytics.
- Primary constraints: PII handling requirements, on-prem data connectors, and 99th percentile latency targets under 300ms for critical routes.
- Next step: Technical deep dive with your ML lead + infra/ops to review model choices, network/VPC options, and pilot scope.

Proposed time windows (PT):
1) Tue May 4 — 10:00–11:30 AM
2) Wed May 5 — 2:00–3:30 PM
3) Thu May 6 — 2:00–3:30 PM

Proposed agenda (60–90m):
- 0–10m: Intros & objectives
- 10–30m: Deep-dive on data flow & security (VPC, KMS, retention)
- 30–60m: Serving architecture & perf targets (batching, KV cache, quant profiles)
- 60–75m: Integration plan & required access (sample data, test endpoints)
- 75–90m: Q&A / next steps / owners

Can you confirm which time works best and who from your side will join (titles/emails) so we can get the right Redwood folks (Camila for infra/implementation, Dylan for runtime/perf) on the invite?

If you prefer different slots/times, share a few options and we’ll accommodate. Once we lock the time I’ll send a calendar invite and attach a short draft agenda and pre-reads.

Thanks — look forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
